policy: No generic automatic suppression rule for repeated terminal numbers is accepted. Diagnose full cabinet/strip/terminal identity, preserve candidates and require semantic review.

observed_mechanism.behavior: Unresolved questions remain operation_pending with suppressed_as_false=False; admitted candidates carry operation_semantic_verified=False.
Starts from deep copies of all classic findings and appends candidates. This additive step does not interpret an operation receipt as an instruction to delete classic findings.

boundary: This establishes the bounded method and the lack of an accepted terminal-suppression rule, not a claim that every downstream model can never remove a terminal finding. The AK known grouping replay is a positive control, not a substitute historical negative pair.
acceptance_condition: Keep suppression unsupported until an independent same-scope historical negative control and a protected positive pair are established.
